stem: Voltmarkt wants the CAC payback of Business Care, its device-support subscription for small offices, to stay at 12 months or less. Next month it expects €2,500 of new-business MRR at a gross margin of 60%. Using CAC payback = sales and marketing expense / (new-business MRR × gross margin), what is the most it can spend on sales and marketing that month? Give it in thousands of euros with 1 decimal, for example 12.5 for €12,500.
